# Key bindings

<!-- Generated by documentation.lua from keybindings.lua. Do not edit by hand:
     change keybindings.lua, then run `lua documentation.lua` in the plugin folder. -->

vi-xournalpp starts in **tool mode**. Press a mode key to enter another mode:
the next key runs one action there and takes you back to tool mode.
Enter a mode with **Shift** to make it **sticky**: it stays active until you press `t`.
A key that does nothing in a one-shot mode acts as it would in tool mode,
and `t` returns to tool mode from every mode.

| Mode | Enter | Sticky |
|---|---|---|
| [Tool](#tool-mode) | `t` |  |
| [Color](#color-mode) | `c` | `Shift+c` |
| [Shape](#shape-mode) | `s` | `Shift+s` |
| [Linestyle](#linestyle-mode) | `l`, `q` | `Shift+l` |
| [Page](#page-mode) | `b`, `p` | `Shift+b`, `Shift+p` |
| [File](#file-mode) | `f` | `Shift+f` |
| [Navigation](#navigation-mode) | `n` | `Shift+n` |
| [Visual](#visual-mode) | `v` | `Shift+v` |
| [Resize](#resize-mode) | `r` | `Shift+r` |

<a id="tool-mode"></a>

## Tool mode (`t`)

* Annotate PDF: `o`
* Delete: `x`
* Eraser: `e`
* Hand: `Space`
* Highlighter: `h`
* LaTeX: `i`
* New page after: `a`
* Pen: `w`
* Redo: `y`
* Selection: `k`
* Text: `Shift+i`, `Shift+t`
* Undo: `d`, `u`, `z`
* Zoom in: `>`, `+`
* Zoom out: `<`, `-`

<a id="color-mode"></a>

## Color mode (`c`, sticky `Shift+c`)

* Black: `x`
* Blue: `b`
* Cyan: `c`
* Green: `g`
* Orange: `o`
* Pink: `q`
* Purple: `a`, `p`
* Red: `r`
* White: `w`
* Yellow: `y`

<a id="shape-mode"></a>

## Shape mode (`s`, sticky `Shift+s`)

* Arrow: `a`
* Ellipse: `e`
* Fill: `f`
* Rectangle: `c`, `r`
* Ruler: `s`
* Spline: `b`

<a id="linestyle-mode"></a>

## Linestyle mode (`l`, `q`, sticky `Shift+l`)

* Dash-dotted: `a`, `h`
* Dashed: `d`
* Dotted: `o`
* Plain: `l`, `p`

<a id="page-mode"></a>

## Page mode (`b`, `p`, sticky `Shift+b`, `Shift+p`)

* Copy page: `c`
* Delete layer: `x`
* Delete page: `d`
* Dotted background: `v`
* Graph background: `g`
* Isometric dotted background: `b`
* Isometric graph background: `r`
* Move page down: `s`
* Move page up: `w`
* New layer: `y`
* New page after: `a`
* New page before: `Shift+a`
* Plain background: `n`
* Ruled background: `f`

<a id="file-mode"></a>

## File mode (`f`, sticky `Shift+f`)

* Annotate PDF: `a`, `o`
* Export as PDF: `e`
* Open file: `f`
* Save file: `s`, `w`
* Save file as: `Shift+s`, `Shift+w`

<a id="navigation-mode"></a>

## Navigation mode (`n`, sticky `Shift+n`)

* Go back to last visited page: `a`
* Go to bottom: `b`
* Go to first page: `g`
* Go to last page: `e`, `Shift+g`
* Go to top: `Shift+b`
* Layer down: `x`
* Layer up: `y`
* Scroll page down: `s`
* Scroll page up: `w`

<a id="visual-mode"></a>

## Visual mode (`v`, sticky `Shift+v`)

* Select object: `o`
* Select rectangle: `r`, `v`
* Select region: `e`

<a id="resize-mode"></a>

## Resize mode (`r`, sticky `Shift+r`)

* Fine: `f`
* Medium: `m`, `r`
* Thick: `h`
* Very fine: `e`
* Very thick: `v`
